text: Tamar's dad is back in hospital, chest infection again. She's driving up to Leeds tomorrow morning. Text her Thursday to see how he's doing.
Camila has her second interview with the council on Friday at 3pm. She's really nervous about the presentation part.
nora grad 14 july, cardiff. her mum flying in from lisbon
Angela said her little one starts reception on the 3rd of September and she's already dreading the drop off. Should send her something that morning.
Laila broke her wrist falling off her bike on Sunday. Cast for six weeks, can't drive. Offer to do the school run for her next week.
Dimitri applied for the senior analyst job at Santos & Lewis. Hears back by 21/10.
Quick one - Aisha's son got his GCSE mocks back and did way better than expected. She's thrilled.
Shreya mentioned her partner Ibrahim has his PhD viva on 2 December at 10am. He's been a wreck about it apparently. Don't forget to wish him luck the night before.
Chidi off work with shingles, says it's agony. His boss has been decent about it at least.
Wei - dentist job interview Monday at half 9, needs to bring certificates. Lent her my nice folder.

Talked to Kiri on the phone. Wiremu (her husband) is having knee surgery on the 12th, first thing. She's taking the week off to look after him and their two boys. Kiri mentioned she's been sleeping badly with the worry. I said I'd drop round a lasagne. Must check in with her the weekend after, maybe Saturday afternoon.
pooja's daughter got into Bristol for medicine!! results came in this morning
Tadhg's mam had a fall at home, she's ok but bruised. He's going down to Cork on Friday evening for the weekend.
Hoang says he's done applying for grad schemes, sixteen rejections and he's taking a break. Bit flat. Check in with him in a couple of weeks.
Rory - Rors - has his driving test 8 Nov at 2.40pm. Third attempt. Remind me to text him good luck that morning.
Freya's graduating from nursing on 18th of January. Her gran's coming over from Galway for it. Gift idea: she keeps saying she needs a decent fob watch.
Tunde got the job!!! Starts 4 Nov at the Brennan Foundation. Send congrats.
Sara cancelled the interview prep session we had booked Weds at 6, her daughter's got a temperature.
Bridget and Jonah's twins start secondary school next month. Bridget's more anxious than the girls are.
need to buy cough mixture and paracetamol before Saturday
Yusuf told me his little girl lost her first tooth last night and the tooth fairy forgot. Ha.
Manon's mum diagnosed with type 2 diabetes. Manon's been reading everything about it. She's vegetarian so cooking for her mum is a bit of a puzzle apparently.
Krisztina phone interview went well yesterday. Final round is the 29th at 11am in person. Ask her after how it went.
Anan's had a migraine since Tuesday, tried everything. GP appointment tomorrow at 8.20.
Sinead texted - her boy Wiremu has his grade 5 piano exam on 15 Nov. She's paying for extra lessons and he's not best pleased lol
Damian interview at the hospital trust went badly, he thinks. Says he froze on the competency questions. Should ring him tonight.
Miriam's husband Damian is recovering from a hernia op, home since Monday. She's run ragged with the kids and work.
Elif's graduation ceremony - 9 Dec, 2pm, Ussher Hall. I'm going with her parents.
Tamar again: dad discharged Tuesday. Relief all round.
Camila's interview was cancelled last minute, they've frozen the role. She's gutted, it was the one she really wanted.
Note to self - my appraisal Thursday 10am, prep notes Weds night.
Nora said her brother Tadhg's doing his A levels this summer and wants to do engineering at Imperial.
Aisha's dog Biscuit had his op today, came through fine. Vet says crate rest for ten days.
Ibrahim passed his viva with minor corrections! Need to organise something for him, maybe drinks on the 6th.
Shreya's mum is in hospital in Pune with pneumonia, Shreya's flying out on Sunday at 7am. Message her Monday to see how her mum is.
Laila mentioned her son has a speech therapy assessment on 4/11. They've waited eight months for it.

dictated: okay so Wei texted back she got the dentist job, starts 2nd of December, she's over the moon, and she says thank you for the folder which made me laugh, anyway should get her a little something, she likes those fancy Japanese pens
Chidi and his wife Elif are expecting, due in March! He told me at football but said keep it quiet for now.
Pooja's dad has his cataract op 3 Nov morning. She's driving him in at 7.
Tadhg's kid started Montessori this week. Cried every day so far apparently, Tadhg too.
Hoang has an interview after all - Wednesday 2pm with Olsen Engineering. Didn't even remember applying. Text him Tuesday night.
Uncle Wiremu's 70th is on the 22nd of November. Kiri says he wants nothing but secretly would love a new fishing reel.
Spoke to Rory's mum. Rory passed his test!! First time I've seen her cry from happiness.
Freya off sick with tonsillitis, missed her placement assessment Friday. Rescheduled to 30/10 at 1pm.
Tunde's son is sitting his 11+ on 14 September. Tunde's more nervous than the kid. Remind me to ask Tunde how it went that evening.
Sara's daughter better now, back at school. Rebooked our session for Monday at 6.

Bridget's mother-in-law is having chemo, starts the 7th. Bridget is doing all the hospital runs while Jonah's away with work. She sounded exhausted. I should take her for coffee one morning, she won't ask for help.

Long call with Yusuf. He's been made redundant, last day is 31st October. He's applying for everything, has an interview with Bianchi Logistics next Thursday at 9 and another with a recruitment agency. His wife Bridget Lopez's been brilliant but they're worried about the mortgage. He also said their eldest started uni in Manchester so money's tight. Don't forget to ring him the day after the Bianchi one.
Manon starts her new job at the library on the 1st. Part time, but she loves it already.
Krisztina didn't get it. Second place again. She's going to ask for feedback.
Anan - migraine was a sinus infection in the end. On antibiotics. Allergic to penicillin so they gave him something else.
Sinead's lad passed his piano exam with distinction! Sinead couldn't stop telling everyone.
dropping Damian's spare keys back tomorrow at lunch
Miriam said Damian's back at work on light duties from Monday. Their youngest starts nursery on the 10th.
Elif mentioned her sister Pooja has a job interview in Istanbul on the 2nd of November at 4pm. She's flying out the day before. Elif thinks she'll get it.
Angela's youngest has chickenpox, whole house in quarantine. She's had to cancel his birthday party on Saturday. Drop off some colouring books.
Dimitri got through to the second round. Interview 28/10 at 3.30pm, panel of five. He's nervous about the technical bit.
Tamar says her dad keeps forgetting his meds, she's worried it's more than just age. Tamar works nights at the hospital herself so can't be there much.
Kiri: Wiremu's surgery went well, home Friday. Boys being angels. Ask her how his physio's going in a fortnight.
Freya mentioned she's thinking of applying for a job in Auckland after graduation. Her boyfriend Jonah isn't sure.
